title: Skybax Car
content: I've always had a fondness for exuberantly painted cars. Here's one in Ohio that features Will Denison fromDinotopia: Journey to Chandarapainted on the hood.In case you couldn't make it out, here's the painting it's based on.I love the wiggly yellow line against the blue and black stripes and the gradation from red to orange. Nice job!Thanks, Azonthus.Previously:Fan Fun,Waterfall City mosaic, andDinotopia in Lego
